narrative.overview: AgentHub is a bench where a developer lays a package out and examines it before letting it into their agent. The interface is a dark, dense instrument panel: graphite surfaces, thin graphite rules, small sans text and monospace readouts. Every screen should feel like taking a measurement, with token budgets, risk levels, MCP commands and rule sections shown as readouts rather than marketing. The system is mid-density and dark-only (`<html class="dark">`, no light theme exists). Depth comes from stacked tonal surfaces and borders, not shadows. One accent, Signal Orange, marks the interactive and the active; green, amber and red are reserved for measured status. The owner rejected the earlier indigo-on-slate palette, the indigo-to-purple gradients and 10-11px text; none of them may return.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal layering: Bench Black page, Panel Graphite cards, Bench Black readout tiles inside cards.
One-pixel Graphite Rule borders on every container.
Monospace for anything a user can copy or run.
Status color only where a value was measured.
Compact type with a 12px floor and bold titles.

rules.name: The Measured Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red mean a value was measured. Never use them for decoration or for a claim nothing checked.

rules.name: The Single Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange is the only accent. Do not add a second brand hue, and never reintroduce Tailwind indigo, violet or blue-tinted slate: that pairing is the stock AI-product look this palette replaced.

rules.name: The Runnable Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything the user can copy, paste or run is set in monospace with a `$` prompt.

rules.name: The Tone-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with the Panel Graphite / Bench Black step and a Graphite Rule border, not with drop shadows.

dos: Do put every runnable command in an Install Pill, set in monospace with the `$` prompt.
Do separate surfaces with the Panel Graphite / Bench Black tonal step and a 1px Graphite Rule border.
Do reserve Pass Green, Caution Amber and Alarm Red for values that were actually measured.
Do use Signal Orange as the single accent for active, focus and hover states, with Bench Black text on any orange fill.
donts: Don't use gradients, or indigo, violet or blue-tinted slate anywhere.
Don't show a "verified", "passed" or "clean" state that is not derived from real package data.
Don't use drop shadows to create hierarchy.
